vagas.descricao_completa:
Are you looking to work for an innovative and exciting U.S.-based AI company, 100% remotely?
We are looking for a highly skilled and proactive 
AI Engineer (Agentic AI & RAG)
 to join a fast-growing AI automation company serving home-service contractors across the United States.
We are seeking a strong mid-level engineer with hands-on experience building and shipping production AI systems. You will work directly with the Founder to design, develop, and deploy AI agents, multi-step workflows, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems that solve real business problems.
This is a 
full-time, fully remote position
 for candidates based in Latin America. 
Availability U.S. Eastern Time.
ALL RESUMES MUST BE SUBMITTED IN ENGLISH
The salary range is 
$5,500–$6,500 USD per month
, depending on experience.
Responsibilities:
Design, build, and deploy production-ready AI agents and multi-step workflows.
Develop agentic systems using frameworks and technologies such as LangGraph, CrewAI, MCP, tool calling, and function calling.
Build and optimize RAG pipelines, including document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector databases, and retrieval.
Evaluate and improve retrieval quality and overall AI system performance.
Identify and solve production issues such as poor retrieval, runaway tool loops, latency, and unexpected cost spikes.
Work directly with the Founder to translate business requirements into scalable AI solutions.
Maintain secure development practices, including proper secrets handling, access control, and data minimization.
Work directly within the client's repositories, infrastructure, and technology stack.
Take ownership of AI systems from development through production deployment and ongoing optimization.-
Requirements:
Fluent English — YOU MUST BE ABLE TO HAVE A FLUENT PROFESSIONAL CONVERSATION IN ENGLISH.
2–5+ years of professional software development experience using Python and/or TypeScript/Node.js.
Proven hands-on experience building and shipping 
Agentic AI systems into production
, not only personal projects, courses, or tutorials.
Experience with technologies such as 
LangGraph, CrewAI, MCP, tool/function calling, and multi-step agent orchestration.
Proven production experience with 
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
.
Strong understanding of 
document ingestion, chunking strategies, embeddings, retrieval, and vector databases
 such as Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, or pgvector.
Experience evaluating and improving 
retrieval quality and AI system performance
.
Ability to troubleshoot real-world production AI failure modes.
Strong software engineering and secure development practices.
Ability to work independently, take ownership, and collaborate directly with company leadership.
Nice to Have:
Experience building 
Voice AI
 solutions.
Experience with 
Twilio and/or ElevenLabs
.
Experience integrating AI agents with external APIs, CRMs, business systems, or automation platforms.
Experience working in a startup or fast-moving AI environment.
Important:
 Candidates should have real production AI projects they can discuss in detail, including AI agents and RAG systems they personally helped design, build, and deploy.

In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. Only applications of candidates who self-identify as female will be evaluated for this role.
Please submit your resume in English - we can only consider applications submitted in this language.

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
1 year of experience with software development in one or more programming languages (e.g., Python, C, C++, Java, JavaScript).
Preferred qualifications:
1 year of experience in machine learning technology.
About The Job
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.
Google is an engineering company at heart. We hire people with a broad set of technical skills who are ready to take on some of technology's greatest challenges and make an impact on users around the world. At Google, engineers not only revolutionize search, they routinely work on scalability and storage solutions, large-scale applications and entirely new platforms for developers around the world. From Google Ads to Chrome, Android to YouTube, social to local, Google engineers are changing the world one technological achievement after another.
Responsibilities
Establish and follow software development best practices and a robust engineering culture.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. vagas.descricao_completa:
Description
JOB SUMMARY
We're seeking talented students for our Software Development Engineer (SDE) Internship program in Amazon. This is your opportunity to work alongside experienced developers, contribute to innovative projects, and grow your technical skills at one of the world's leading technology companies.
Key Responsibilities
 You will collaborate with experienced Amazonians to design and develop innovative products and services
 You will work on distributed computing projects that help lead fundamental changes in the industry
 You will create solutions for prediction systems that operate at incredible scale and speed
 You will contribute to building scalable, fault-tolerant storage and query systems
 You will write high-quality code in an agile environment
DAY IN THE LIFE
 Work 6-hour shifts (30 hours per week) between 9:00 AM and 6:00 PM, Monday through Friday
 Partner with your assigned manager and mentor on impactful technical projects
 Collaborate with experienced Software Development Engineers
 Participate in team meetings and technical discussions
 Engage in professional development activities and networking opportunities
About The Team
This internship opportunity is part of Amazon's initiative to increase women's representation in technology. You'll join a supportive environment that values diversity, inclusion, and innovation.
Recruiting Process
 Application submission
 Technical Coding Online Assessment
 Two Final Technical Coding & Behavioral Interviews (Prepare to answer questions in English)
Compensation: Monthly salary ranging from R$ 2,000 to R$ 3,000
Note: Amazon is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage all qualified women to apply, as this position is part of our initiative to increase gender diversity in tech roles.
Key job responsibilities
 Collaborate with experienced cross-disciplinary Amazonians to conceive, design, and bring innovative products and services to market.
 Collaborate to design and build innovative technologies in a large distributed computing environment, and help lead fundamental changes in the industry.
 Collaborate to create solutions to run predictions on distributed systems with exposure to innovative technologies at incredible scale and speed.
 Collaborate to build distributed storage, index, and query systems that are scalable, fault-tolerant, low cost, and easy to manage/use.
 Ability to design and code the right solutions starting with broadly defined problems.
 Work in an agile environment to deliver high-quality software.
A day in the life
Selected interns must be available 6 hours per day within a 9:00am to 6:00pm window, from Monday through Friday.
About The Team
Prior applying, please consider:
Recruiting Process
Application > Technical Coding Online Assessment > Two (2) Final Technical Coding & Behavioral Interviews in English.
Recruiting Instructions
Within two (2) business days of successfully submitting your application, you will receive our SDE Internship Technical Coding Online Assessment. Please take time to study/practice in advance and complete within the deadline instructed by the assessment.
IMPORTANT: You will be required to complete two sections 1) Technical Coding with the programming language of your preference, and 2) work-behavioral assessment. Make sure to complete both parts.
Technical Coding Preparation Resources
As we want all applicants to be successful, we've compiled the following preparation resources, which can be taken any time of your choosing. We encourage all applicants to review and bookmark them:
 General Data Structures, Algorithms and CS Concepts: https://www.youtube.com/user/mycodeschool
 Hackerrank Preparation Kit: https://www.hackerrank.com/interview/interview-preparation-kit
 Hackerrank Coding Sample Test: https://www.hackerrank.com/test/5panef6t3s8/9350ef132a3868f0f6424bb42fc61911
 Amazon SDE Coding Example: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yKz2kPip4sg
 Amazon Online Preparation Course for SDE roles: https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/university-roles/sde
 Amazon University Recorded Preparation Session for Coding Online Assessment and Final Technical Coding & Behavioral Interviews: https://linktr.ee/amzuniversitylatam
 System Design will not be evaluated for this SDE I hiring process.
Basic Qualifications
 Currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s degree program in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, with an expected graduation date of December 2027 or later.
 Proficiency in one of the following programming languages: Java, Python, Ruby, Node.js, C#, or C++.
 Knowledge of the fundamentals of networking, security, databases (relational and/or NoSQL), and operating systems (Unix, Linux, and/or Windows).
 High intermediate proficiency in English.
 Availability for a 12-month internship.
 Availability to work 6 hours per day, Monday through Friday (30 hours per week), during standard business hours.
Preferred Qualifications
 Fluent in Portuguese
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

vagas.descricao_resumida: 3Y Health - Brasil
vagas.descricao_completa:
About 3Y Health
3Y Health is building the operating system for healthcare practices, an AI-native platform that helps clinicians start, run and grow their practice. We work as a managed services organization (MSO): along with the software, our operations team runs the back office for the clinics we partner with, including billing, insurance and compliance. We currently serve applied behavior analysis (ABA) therapy practices and are expanding into speech, occupational and physical therapy, and psychiatry.
About The Role
Members of Technical Staff own features end to end. You'll work with the clinicians and operators who use what we build, scope the problem, design and build the solution across the stack, deploy it and follow how it performs in production. Our engineering team is flat, with no sub-teams, so you'll work across the whole platform. We build with AI coding agents every day and expect you to do the same.
What You'll Do
Design and build AI agents and automated workflows for clinic operations, such as insurance benefits verification, prior authorizations, patient intake, claims and clinical documentation
Build features for clinicians, patients and families, and our internal operations team, on web and mobile
Take ambiguous problems from 0 to 1, working with operators and clinicians to define the problem, write the spec and ship a first version
Design the services, data models and APIs behind your features and manage the infrastructure as code
Own your services in production: deployments, monitoring and incident response
Write evals for model-facing features and track the metrics of the workflows you ship
Work with protected health information (PHI) safely, with least-privilege access, no PHI in logs and auditable changes
Build and maintain the skills, plugins, MCP integrations and review bots our engineers use with Claude Code and Codex
Our stack
Backend: Python (our primary language for new services), Kotlin with Hasura (GraphQL) on our established platform, plus TypeScript (NestJS) and some Go
Frontend and mobile: React, Next.js, React Native
Data: PostgreSQL (including pgvector), Snowflake
Workflows and contracts: Temporal, gRPC/Protobuf
Infrastructure: AWS (ECS Fargate, RDS), Terraform, GitHub Actions, Datadog, LaunchDarkly
AI: Claude and OpenAI models, Claude Code and Codex, with our own skills, plugins, MCP integrations and an AI code-review bot
Must-haves
5+ years of experience building and shipping production software
Recent, hands-on experience using or building AI harnesses: the layer around a model or coding agent (project instructions, tools and MCP servers, skills, hooks, subagents, evals), not only calls to a model API. You can show what you set up or built. 
At least one personal project you built and published on the web, live and usable by anyone, ideally a SaaS with payments working (e.g. Stripe). Share the link when you apply. 
What We're Looking For
A track record of owning products or features end to end, from an unclear problem to a system people depend on
Strong full-stack skills in Python and TypeScript, with experience across frontend, backend, databases and cloud infrastructure
Comfort working in a large, established codebase
Hands-on experience building with LLMs, including tool use, agent orchestration, structured outputs, retrieval and evals (LangGraph, an agents SDK or similar)
Daily use of AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor. You know how to set them up for a codebase (project instructions, skills, MCP servers, hooks, subagents), run several tasks in parallel and review their output carefully. If you haven't heard of Claude Code, this role is likely not a fit. 
Good product sense and the ability to make solid UI decisions without a dedicated designer, using our component library
High agency: you unblock yourself, look for context and ask questions when you need to
Clear written communication. The team is distributed across time zones and most decisions happen in specs, PRs and tickets. 
Nice to have
Experience in healthcare or another regulated industry (HIPAA, payer and claims workflows, EHR integrations, HL7/FHIR)
Temporal or another durable workflow engine
React Native
Running LLM evaluations or safety checks on model output in production
Having built your own agent harness, MCP server or plugin for a coding agent
Open-source work or internal tools that other people use
If you meet all the must-haves and most of the rest, we'd like to hear from you, even if you don't check every other box.

Join Cargill's global team of 160,000 employees who use new technologies, dynamic insights and over 154 years of experience to connect farmers with markets, customers with ingredients, and people and animals with the food they need to thrive.

The Software Engineer maintains, partners to design, and develops software applications and systems with a core focus on backend development and the Pricefx platform. With limited supervision, this role collaborates with cross-functional teams to implement technical requirements, deliver functional features based on assigned Jira stories, and enhance existing systems to improve performance and functionality through clean, efficient, and scalable code. Experience working collaboratively within agile delivery frameworks (Scrum or Kanban) using Jira.

vagas.titulo: Software Engineer - Python - Cloud - graduate level
vagas.descricao_resumida: Canonical - Brasil
vagas.descricao_completa:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring a Software Engineer to develop, test and release improvements to the Ubuntu on public clouds.
The quality and stability of the Ubuntu is critically important, since it's available on every public cloud. You’ll work with teams across Canonical working on Ubuntu team, alongside major cloud partners to develop, test and release improvements to the Ubuntu cloud images. You will also be a voice in communication with our users, ensuring their needs are met.
This role requires quality-oriented software engineering in Python and a focus on software interoperability over a vast range of target releases and environments. Excellent Python skills are a key requirement, with previous contributions to open source Python projects being an advantage. This role involves creating and managing Ubuntu images; therefore, experience in configuring apt, and knowledge of deb packaging and general system administration is advantageous in this role.
Applicants should be passionate about the Ubuntu project and its values and about building tools that are used by millions of people around the world. A personal interest and emphasis on quality, thinking of edge cases, ease of use, documentation, and careful community coordination is important. Ubuntu is used for all kinds of users, from mission-critical environments to hobbyist Ubuntu users; applicants should be ready to work with the whole spectrum of end users and help guide engineering best practices with all of them in mind.
The role entails
Collaborate proactively with a distributed team
Write high quality code, with unit and functional tests, to create new features
Debug issues and produce high quality code to fix them
Review code produced by other engineers
Discuss ideas and investigate to find good solutions
Work from home, with global travel 2 to 4 weeks per year for internal and external events
What we are looking for in you
You love technology and working with brilliant people
You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated
You have a Bachelor’s or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
You have extensive experience with Python on Linux
You have interest in and experience with two or more of the following: Ubuntu Linux systems administration, continuous integration, end-system contract management, Debian packaging, working with public or on premise clouds
Bonus points if you have experience engaging with the open source community
What We Offer Colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
Annual compensation review
Recognition rewards
Annual holiday leave
Maternity and paternity leave
Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Como Produtora de Energia a Voltalia atua em mais de 20 países, desenvolvendo, construindo e mantendo projetos e serviços de energia renovável em cinco tecnologias principais: solar, eólica, hídrica, biomassa e armazenamento. Aqui seu trabalho contribui diretamente para um mundo mais sustentável. Seja impulsionando projetos, otimizando operações ou liderando iniciativas estratégicas, você colaborará com nossa missão de melhorar o meio ambiente global e promover o desenvolvimento local.

Professional software engineering experience, with strong skills in Go, Java or Kotlin.
Solid understanding of software design principles, clean code, and automated testing.
Experience working with relational databases and writing optimised SQL queries.
Track record of delivering features end to end in a production environment.
Ability to work autonomously, take ownership of tasks, and communicate progress proactively.
Why you should join SumUp
🌎 Opportunity to work with a truly global, multicultural team from our dynamic São Paulo or Florianópolis hub. This involves an office-first setup
🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced

Be empowered to do more that matters.
At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. Today, over 4 million businesses in 39 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships.

Job Title
Analista de Dados de Precificação
O que um(a) Analista de Dados de Precificação bem-sucedido(a) faz na Fiserv?
Na Fiserv, o(a) Analista de Dados de Precificação transforma dados em inteligência para definir e/ou orientar decisões politicas de pricing, campanhas e estratégicas de rentabilidade Essa pessoa atua de ponta a ponta, conectando análise de dados, visão financeira e entendimento de negócio para apoiar diferentes modelos comerciais e de parceria. Em um ambiente dinâmico, seu impacto vem da capacidade de estruturar informações, gerar análises robustas e influenciar decisões com autonomia. É uma função para quem quer usar dados para impulsionar resultados e a evolução do negócio.

Desenvolver análises de dados de ponta a ponta para suportar decisões de politica pricing, campanhas e estratégia de rentabilidade.
Construir consultas em SQL para extração, cruzamento, tratamento e validação de dados de múltiplas fontes
Utilizar Python para automação, transformação e exploração analítica de dados
Estruturar bases e organizar informações que nem sempre estarão prontas para uso analítico

Avaliar diferentes modelos de negócio, comissão, remuneração e estruturas de parceria
Traduzir análises em recomendações claras para stakeholders de áreas comerciais, estratégicas e parceiras
Atuar com autonomia na condução de análises e negociações dentro do escopo da função.

Facilidade de relacionamento para atuar com diferentes áreas, parceiros e stakeholders

vagas.titulo: Middle Python Developer with SQL Skills
vagas.descricao_resumida: BETBY - Almaty, Almaty, Cazaquistão
vagas.descricao_completa:
About Betby
As a fast-growing, award-winning company, Betby powers the industry with our premium sportsbook, featuring world-class risk management and seamless omni-channel support, reaching millions of players across countless markets. With offices in Latvia, Malta, Spain, Greece and Montenegro, we offer a vibrant work culture, relocation opportunities, and full support for remote talent across the globe.
Join Betby and unlock endless opportunities for growth, success, and making a real impact in the world of iGaming!
Short Description
We are looking for a Python developer to join the Backoffice Reports team behind the Reports section of our back-office. You will own the backend of analytics reports used daily by operation teams (risk management, trading, account management and etc). The stack is async Python on top of ClickHouse. Reports are described as typed Pydantic models plus Jinja-templated ClickHouse SQL, executed through an RPC service over RabbitMQ and exposed to the UI through REST/GraphQL endpoints with OpenAPI-driven dynamic forms.
TECH STACK
Python 3.13+ (asyncio, Pydantic v2)
SQL
Jinja2 (SQL templating)
GraphQL
REST API
Kafka
RabbitMQ
MongoDB
Docker
Prometheus
Grafana
ELK
#NODJANGO :)
Responsibilities
Develop and maintain reports in the Backoffice: filters, grouping, sorting, pagination, totals, drill-down links between reports, CSV exports and chart data
Write and optimize analytical ClickHouse SQL: aggregations over hundreds of millions of bets, multi-level grouping, period breakdowns (day / week / month / year)
Describe reports as typed contracts (Pydantic models for filters and output) in our shared reports library, which the analytics team also uses to tune queries
Work with the RPC layer between the backoffice API and the ClickHouse reporter service (RabbitMQ)
Implement access control for reports: scopes and roles, operator / brand data isolation, hiding fields depending on user role
Investigate slow reports: read query plans, choose the right filters, PREWHERE, pre-aggregation, and work with the analytics/DataFlow team on table design
Cover reports and SQL with tests, keep data correct across backoffice applications
Take part in code review and help evolve the reports framework (new report types, presets, custom segments)
REQUIREMENTS
3+ years of commercial development in Python
Confident asyncio: async/await, concurrency, async I/O clients
Pydantic v2 (models, validation, serialization) and type hints
Strong SQL - this is the key requirement:
Complex SELECTs with JOINs, subqueries and CTEs (WITH)
GROUP BY on several dimensions, conditional aggregation (SUM / COUNT with conditions)
Window functions
Understanding of how analytical queries scale and why a query is slow
Experience with a columnar / OLAP database (ClickHouse preferred; Vertica, Exasol, BigQuery, Redshift, Snowflake are a plus)
Experience building REST APIs in an async framework (Sanic, aiohttp, FastAPI, Starlette)
Understanding of message brokers (RabbitMQ and/or Kafka) and RPC over queues
Git, Docker, writing tests with pytest
Ability to understand a business metric (GGR, stake, payout, margin, etc.) and turn it into a correct query
NICE TO HAVE
Hands-on ClickHouse: MergeTree family engines, FINAL, PREWHERE, dictionaries (dictGet), -If combinators, ARRAY JOIN, WITH TOTALS, quantiles, uniq / uniqExact
Jinja2 or other SQL templating / query builders
Pandas for data post-processing and exports
MongoDB
GraphQL
Domain knowledge: sports betting, iGaming, fintech or ad-tech analytics
Prometheus / Grafana / ELK for monitoring and troubleshooting
Monorepo tooling (Pants, Poetry, uv), Nix
WHAT WE OFFER
Comprehensive health insurance with coverage for your well-being
Paid sick leave up to 10 days without medical certificate
20 days of paid vacation plus additional leave for important life events
Learning and growth opportunities with support for professional development
Language learning support for multilingual collaboration
Modern hardware provided for your work
International team environment across multiple countries
Corporate events and team activities
Welfare support program for critical situations
Gifts and support for major life milestones 
WHY JOIN OUR DREAM TEAM?
Betbyterians is a passionate team dedicated to creating exceptional B2B betting products. United by trust, support, and fun, we aim to revolutionize online gaming, tackling challenges with agility, creativity, and teamwork. Driven by innovation and strong business practices, our achievements speak for themselves. Experience it first-hand, join us and be part of something extraordinary. Welcome to Betby!

vagas.descricao_resumida: Canonical - Colômbia
vagas.descricao_completa:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring a software engineer to join our Kubernetes product team. As a member of that team, you will build the operators and addons; the former, offering complete lifecycle management of mission-critical components, and the latter, a zero-ops experience for seamlessly integrating projects into your Kubernetes.
You will gain familiarity with the latest features in Kubernetes and look to incorporate the best of open-source to bring functionality to our end-users. You will collaborate with industry peers and partners to bring the right solutions to our customers.
This is an exciting opportunity for a software engineer passionate about open source software, Linux, Golang, Python and Kubernetes.
Location
: This is a remote position available in EMEA and the Americas.
What you will focus on
Write high-quality code to create new features
Debug issues and interact with a vibrant community
Collaborate proactively with a distributed team
Work with helpful and talented engineers including experts in many fields
Work from home with global travel 2 to 4 weeks for internal and external events
What we are looking for in you
Go or Python is required. Experience in both is even better
Kubernetes experience is preferred but not strictly required
You have strong written and verbal communication skills
You have a Bachelor’s or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
You love technology and working with brilliant people
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
Annual compensation review
Recognition rewards
Annual holiday leave
Maternity and paternity leave
Employee Assistance Programme
Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. vagas.descricao_completa:
Software Development Engineer - Full Stack, Backend Focus
2–5 years’ experience | Competitive compensation + potential ESOPs
About Auto Data Catalog
A business question rarely fits neatly inside one database.
Auto Data Catalog (ADC) helps business users ask questions about their company’s data in natural language and get reliable, explainable answers. Our platform builds an evolving knowledge graph of business data to give AI the context it needs to answer accurately.
We’re a small engineering team building a product already being used by customers. We’re hiring two engineers to help tackle our next set of challenges: answering questions across multiple data sources and analyzing uploaded files.
What you’ll build
This is a full-stack role with approximately 
80% of the work in Python backend development
. Our frontend uses React, Next.js and Tailwind, supported by Django REST Framework APIs.
In your first three months, your main focus will be:
Enabling users to ask questions that combine information across multiple data sources.
Helping users upload files and analyze their contents through ADC.
You’ll own features from design through implementation and production, build database integrations and APIs, improve performance and reliability, and contribute to code reviews and technical decisions. You’ll work closely with the founder and other engineers, with direct visibility into how customers use what you build.
What we’re looking for
2–5 years of software development experience
, with hands-on experience building and maintaining backend applications.
Strong programming fundamentals and the ability to reason through unfamiliar problems.
Python proficiency, or strong backend experience in another language and a willingness to become productive in Python quickly.
Experience working with APIs, SQL and relational databases.
The ability to debug issues, write maintainable code and test the behavior that matters.
Clear communication and ownership: you can take a problem, clarify what needs to happen and carry it through to a working solution.
Frontend skills can be learned on the job. Experience with Django REST Framework, React, cloud platforms, Docker, data integrations or LLM applications would be useful.
Why join ADC
Own meaningful parts of an AI product early in its development.
Work on practical problems involving AI, business context, databases and reliable software.
See your work reach customers and use their feedback to improve it.
Help shape engineering decisions and development practices as the team grows.
Compensation
We offer competitive compensation tailored to your skills, experience and the impact you can bring to ADC. We assess each candidate individually, with flexibility for exceptional talent. Additional ESOPs are open for discussion for the right candidate.
Location and work arrangements
Gurugram:
 Our workspace is in Wazirabad, with three days per week in the office.
Bengaluru:
 Candidates can initially work remotely. We may introduce a coworking arrangement as the local team grows.
We plan to establish a dedicated Bengaluru workspace and move the team there in approximately one year. 
Gurugram hires should be willing to relocate to Bengaluru.
Interview process
Two rounds of discussion covering your past work, technical problem-solving and the role. We’re looking for candidates who can join within approximately one month.
How to apply
Apply through the hiring form on 
autodatacatalog.com
. Include a short example - around 150 words - of a backend feature or system you personally built or improved, explaining your contribution and the result. Public code or project links are welcome but optional.
Please use the application form so we can review your application consistently. Applications sent by DM may be missed.

Anwendungsentwicklerinnen / Anwendungsentwickler
für Python (DevOps) (m/w/d)

 Entwicklung unserer Kundenportale: Konzeption und Entwicklung Python-basierter Webanwendungen sowie aktive Mitgestaltung der digitalen Online-Services der BGHW 
 Applikationsbetrieb im DevOps-Umfeld: Gemeinsame Verantwortung im Team für den stabilen Betrieb unserer Anwendungen sowie Entwicklung von Maßnahmen zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung von Stabilität, Performance und Verfügbarkeit

Die Vergütung erfolgt nach Entgeltgruppe 11 BG-AT. Das monatliche Tabellenentgelt beträgt derzeit je nach Stufenzuordnung 4.341,24 € bis 6.776,58 € brutto.
 Eine sinnstiftende und anspruchsvolle Tätigkeit in einem dynamischen Arbeitsumfeld

 Wir fördern die Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Familie sowie Inklusion mit vielfältigen Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten und legen Wert auf eine gesunde Work-Life-Balance (flexible Arbeitszeiten - großzügiger Gleitzeitrahmen -, individuelle Arbeits- und Teilzeitmodelle, mobiles Arbeiten, Beratung in allen Bereichen der Kinderbetreuung und Pflegebedürftigkeit) 
 Einen individuell auf Sie abgestimmten Onboarding-Prozess 
 Gesundheit und Sicherheit haben bei uns Priorität - das geht von Sport- und Bewegungsangeboten bis hin zu vielfältigen Schulungsmöglichkeiten rund um Gesundheit und Sicherheit 
 Wir investieren in die fachliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung unserer Mitarbeitenden 
Ihr Profil
 Abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium (Bachelor / Diplom) der Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation 
 Sicherer Umgang mit Python sowohl in der Entwicklung als auch zur Automatisierung von Betriebsprozessen 
 Entwicklung mit einem hohen Qualitätsanspruch sowie Fokus auf Clean Code, Wartbarkeit und Testbarkeit 
 Kenntnisse in modernen DevOps-Methoden und Entwicklungswerkzeugen, insbesondere in den Bereichen CI / CD, Containerisierung, Linux, Versionsverwaltung (Git), Codequalität (z. B. SonarQube), relationale Datenbanken (z. B. PostgreSQL) sowie in der Entwicklung und Anbindung von REST- / SOAP-Schnittstellen 
 Eigenverantwortliches, strukturiertes Arbeiten und Freude am gemeinsamen Lösen komplexer Herausforderungen im Team 
 Idealerweise Erfahrung als DevOps Engineer oder Site Reliability Engineer in einem agilen Arbeitsumfeld 
 Sichere mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikation in deutscher Sprache (mindestens Niveau C1) 
 Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Dienstreisen 
Kontakt
Bitte bewerben Sie sich bis 03.11.2026 mit aussagekräftigen Unterlagen.
Fragen zur Stelle beantwortet: Frau Podzuweit, Tel.: 0228 5406 5719
Die BGHW will Frauen aktiv fördern. Bewerbungen von Frauen werden deshalb ausdrücklich begrüßt.

Wir über uns
Die Berufsgenossenschaft Handel und Warenlogistik ist Trägerin der gesetzlichen Unfallversicherung für Unternehmen und deren Beschäftigte im Handel und in der Warenlogistik. Wir verstehen uns als moderner Dienstleister für ca. 4,6 Millionen Versicherte in rund 380.000 Unternehmen. vagas.descricao_completa:
At Franklin Templeton, we believe success is built through powerful partnerships. As a forward thinking asset manager, we build dynamic relationships with clients, understand their goals, and navigate complex markets together. We leverage cutting edge strategies and deep insights to unlock opportunities for long term wealth creation. Our talented, global teams bring expertise that is both broad and unique.
From our welcoming, inclusive, and supportive culture to our globally diverse business, we offer opportunities not only to help you reach your potential, but also to contribute to our clients’ success.
About The Department
Our direct team is based in the USA. The team supports batch systems for FADB, our funds accounting database, and for GPW, the downstream system that reports product performance. The immediate team is currently three full-time employees.
A Software Developer builds, tests and ships solutions for the Business Data Solutions team at Franklin Templeton as a permanent employee. This is an individual contributor role.
You will deliver production-quality services and web applications built on Python (Django and FastAPI) and Oracle PL/SQL, work independently on well-defined problems, and use AI tools responsibly to improve speed and quality. Your work gives the business reliable features.
Core Responsibilities
How you will add value
You will develop new code and configuration for complete features across a Django web application, Django REST and FastAPI REST APIs, Oracle PL/SQL and batch processes, and maintain automatable test cases.
You will develop automated build and deployment methods using GitLab CI/CD pipelines, containers and AWS services such as Lambda, S3 and ECS Fargate.
You will troubleshoot defects across browser, service, database and batch processes, proving the cause before changing code.
Strategic Responsibilities
You will analyze requirements, propose high-level solutions, and document new code and configurations for complete features.
You will contribute to shared libraries, reusable components, project plans and effort estimates.
Team & Collaboration
You will review source code of more junior engineers, applying basic business domain knowledge.
You will build effective working relationships with other technical teams, and explain technical choices clearly to technical and non-technical colleagues.
You will support production batch processes for FADB and GPW, and document issue resolutions
What Will Help You Be Successful In This Role
Experience, Education & Certifications 
1-4 Years Of Experience
Uses AI assistants as a natural part of their development workflow: for writing code, debugging, writing tests, generating documentation, and exploring unfamiliar domains.
Decomposes a task into parts, translates those parts into effective prompts, and iterates on those prompts until the task is complete.
Treats AI-generated outputs as drafts, not final, and refines them before incorporating.
Actively explores new AI tools, techniques, and capabilities.
4 + years of experience
Approaches system design, architecture, or technical decisions, considering where AI can meaningfully improve the solution, not just the development process.
Evaluates trade-offs between AI-assisted and traditional approaches with practical judgement.
Identifies repetitive, manual, or error-prone processes in their team's work and introduces AI-powered improvements, including but not limited to code reviews, AI-assisted testing, intelligent alerting, or document generation.
Applies advanced prompting techniques to tackle ambiguous, multi-step or domain specific problems.
Technical Environment
Core stack: Python and Oracle PL/SQL, with a Django web application (using Django REST) and FastAPI REST APIs, both running on ECS Fargate.
Operating environment: AWS cloud, with some workloads on Linux EC2 and some container-based (ECS Fargate).
Workflow: Git and GitLab CI/CD, AWS Lambda workflows and S3, [ticketing and SDLC to add].
Quality and reliability: unit and integration testing, code review, and production troubleshooting of applications and batch processes.
Technical Skills
Python development, including Django web applications (with Django REST) and FastAPI REST APIs.
Oracle: strong SQL and PL/SQL development.
AWS: working knowledge of services such as Lambda, S3, EC2 and ECS Fargate.
Testing: unit and integration testing, with exposure to test automation.
Working knowledge of Git-based workflows, GitLab CI/CD and containerized deployment, and sound practice on authentication, authorization and API security.
Demonstrated, hands-on experience building and supporting applications and batch processes in production.
Clear written and verbal communication, effective teamwork, and a record of owning work through to completion.
Experience with AWS Lambda, S3 or ECS Fargate, and with Linux on EC2 would be a plus.
Practical experience applying LLMs or AI coding assistants, including evaluating the quality of their output would be a plus.
Experience in financial services or other regulated environments would be a plus.

vagas.descricao_completa:
Who We Are…
GlobalData Healthcare operates an intelligence platform that empowers leaders to act decisively in a world of complexity and change.
By uniting proprietary data, human expertise, and purpose-built AI into a single, connected platform, we help organizations see what’s coming, move faster, and lead with confidence.
Our solutions are used by over 5,000 organizations across the world’s largest industries, delivering tailored intelligence that supports strategic planning, innovation, risk management, and sustainable growth.
Why join GlobalData?
GlobalData Healthcare is GlobalData’s largest division, and at a pivotal point in its growth journey. Following multiple acquisitions and having recently received transformational investment, we are in the process of being carved out from the main GlobalData business. We need curious, ambitious, courageous people to support us in achieving our vision to deliver intelligence that transforms uncertainty into opportunity for the world’s most successful organizations.
Our big ambitions mean that life at GlobalData Healthcare is fast paced, entrepreneurial and rewarding. Working together in an intellectually challenging environment, where learning is super-charged to keep us on our toes, the highly stimulating, fast-paced, global environment we operate in, and our bold ambitions result in unique learning opportunities for our people.
The role…
GlobalData Healthcare is building an AI-enabled competitive intelligence platform for the pharmaceutical market. It supports our consulting teams in tracking competitor drugs, clinical trials, regulatory decisions and market news for pharma clients, combining GlobalData's data, continuous monitoring of external sources, AI-assisted analysis and the expertise of our consultants. The platform runs on AWS, with a Python and PostgreSQL back end and a React front end. We are forming a small Birmingham-based team to develop and run it.
You will build and develop the web application our consultants use every day to manage competitive landscapes, forecast timelines and the review and sign-off of intelligence for pharma clients. You will work across the React user interface and the Python services behind it.
What You’ll Be Doing…
Develop new features end to end, from database and API through to the user interface. 
Build clear, usable interfaces for complex, data-rich workflows. 
Work directly with users to gather feedback and improve the application. 
Maintain code quality through testing, code review and shared standards. 
Help keep the application secure, performant and consistent as it grows. 
Essential
What we’re looking for…
At least 2 years' commercial experience with React and TypeScript, ideally on data-rich business applications. 
Experience building REST APIs, ideally in Python (e.g. FastAPI). 
Good working knowledge of SQL and relational databases, ideally PostgreSQL. 
Good judgement on user interface design, with or without a dedicated designer. 
Understanding of authentication, access control and web application security. 
Desirable 
Experience building products that present or work alongside AI-generated content. 
Experience with applications hosted on AWS, and CI/CD. 
Background in life sciences, healthcare or market intelligence. 
In addition to a rewarding career, we support our GlobalData Heathcare colleagues with a range of benefits across health, finances, fitness, travel, tech and more. To find out more about the roles and benefits on offer in your region, visit careers.globaldata.com
GlobalData Healthcare believes strongly in the value of diversity and creating supportive, inclusive environments where our colleagues can succeed. As such, we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. GlobalData Healthcare is determined to ensure that no applicant or employee receives less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, age, disability, religion, belief, sexual orientation, marital status, race, or is disadvantaged by conditions or requirements which cannot be shown to be justifiable.

Now we want to go further: turn more of our experts' playbooks into systems that run themselves, so delivery gets faster, more consistent and less dependent on any one person. About the Company
Willow Processing is modernizing the technology behind its loan processing operations and developing integrations that connect the business with lending partners. The company is building systems and tools to improve internal workflows and support its loan processing services.
About the Role
Willow Processing is seeking a backend-leaning Full-Stack Software Engineer to join its small engineering team. This role offers the opportunity to take ownership of meaningful projects and contribute across the full software development lifecycle, from planning and design to development, deployment, and monitoring.
The position focuses on building backend services, partner-facing APIs, and web interfaces, as well as developing AI-powered automation for internal workflows. You will also help migrate data and business logic from legacy systems while maintaining uninterrupted live operations. The ideal candidate is comfortable making technical decisions independently, working through ambiguity, and collaborating with teammates and operations staff when needed.
Key Responsibilities
Own features end to end, including scoping, design, development, deployment, and monitoring.
Collaborate with engineering teammates and operations staff on larger projects.
Build backend services and APIs for lending partners.
Develop and improve web interfaces used by internal staff and external users.
Create AI-powered automation for internal workflows, incorporating appropriate safeguards and human review.
Migrate data and business logic from legacy systems without disrupting live operations.
Make sound technical decisions independently and maintain progress without waiting for detailed direction.
Required Qualifications
At least 3 years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong backend focus.
Experience with TypeScript/Node.js or Python, ideally.
Solid frontend development skills using a modern framework such as React or Next.js.
Production experience designing and operating APIs, including authentication, idempotency, retries, and observability.
Strong relational database and data migration skills.
Hands-on experience building with AI tools, including LLM APIs, prompt design, tool use, or agent workflows, ideally using Python.
Good judgment about where AI systems require checks and safeguards.
Proven ability to take work from initial idea through production.
Ability to collaborate effectively when working on shared projects.
Comfort working in a fast-paced environment with ambiguity.
Clear written communication skills for remote teamwork.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience shipping AI features into production.
DevOps experience, including CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and deployment automation.
Experience in fintech, lending, or mortgage industries.
Previous experience working in a startup or small engineering team.
Compensation & Work Arrangement
Annual Salary: $85,000–$95,000.
Work Arrangement: Fully remote.
Eligible Candidates: Candidates based in the United States.
Work Authorization: Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.
Interview Process
15-minute initial screening call.
One-hour technical interview involving situational questions about approaching real-world problems. No live coding or take-home assessment is required.
Final conversation with the founder.

Apply through LinkedIn and answer the screening questions honestly. The team reviews applications directly.
Candidates selected for further consideration will receive a few short written questions by email. Applicants should ensure that the email address on their LinkedIn profile is current.

vagas.descricao_completa:
About Nooks.ai
Nooks is an applied AI lab building revenue agents that power some of the fastest growing companies in the world. We build AI agents that operate across the full revenue lifecycle, from account strategy to prospect research and outreach. Building 0→1 has never been easier, but selling at the speed of the market remains the last frontier for AI. Our mission is to 10x every seller by automating the busywork so they can focus on what humans do best: closing deals.
Today, over 2000 customers power their revenue growth using Nooks, including Notion, HubSpot, Cursor, and Rippling. We've raised over 70M USD from top VCs like Kleiner Perkins, and we have more than tripled ARR each year for 3 years running.
Build the future of AI-powered work.
At Nooks, we're building AI agents that automate the most important function for every company: revenue generation.
Our customers use Nooks to build agents that research accounts, run outreach, and work deals across the whole revenue lifecycle. They trust us to deliver the infrastructure across text, voice, computer use, and data to power their inbound, outbound, and deal execution. Every day, thousands of users rely on Nooks to do the work that used to take entire teams of people.
Because every company in the world has a revenue function, we're still incredibly early in our product lifecycle, which means engineers have an outsized impact. You'll ship production code on your first day, own projects from idea to production, talk directly with our customers, and help define what building and maintaining AI-native enterprise software looks like.
You will get a chance to redefine your career helping companies solve their hardest problems, building products people genuinely love, and working alongside a team that is high-intensity, high-trust, low-ego, and playing to win, we'd love to meet you.
What You'll Do
Design, build, and ship using React, TypeScript, Node.js, and Python.
Own projects from initial idea through deployment, monitoring, and iteration.
Work directly with customers to understand their problems and turn feedback into product improvements.
Build product that powers agent-building, real-time collaboration, enterprise-scale workflows and automations, and human-agent interaction.
Improve the performance, reliability, and scalability of our platform and infrastructure.
Build low-latency voice AI on live calls that power live coaching and voice agents.
Build the software factory that can accelerate agent engineering and product maintenance.
Work across the entire agent development lifecycle, from agent-building to simulations and evals to monitoring and feedback loops.
Improve the efficiency and cost of our agents, through better agent design and context engineering.
Write clean, maintainable code and contribute thoughtful feedback and review.
What We're Looking For
We're much more interested in how you think and the outcomes you are ambitious enough to drive than whether you've used every technology in our stack.
You'll Likely Be a Great Fit If You
Are completing or recently completed a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field.
Have built software and agents through internships, research, open source, startups, or personal projects.
Have gotten stuck on something hard and found a way to push through.
Care whether what you build matters to the people using it.
Love learning new technologies and figuring out how to use them to solve problems for people. Experience with React, TypeScript, Node.js, or Python is a plus, but not required.
Thrive in fast-moving environments where engineers take ownership and make product decisions.
Able to collaborate with teammates, be truth-seeking and low-ego, and communicate technical ideas clearly.
Can work from our San Francisco or Seattle offices.
How We Work
Ownership. You’ll ship to production on your first day. From there, you'll progressively take ownership of larger features while pairing closely with experienced engineers, learning about our customer problems, product, and infrastructure. By the end of your first few months, you'll be expected to own both customer and product outcomes end-to-end. You’ll talk directly to customers, watch how they use what you built, and decide what to change.
Customer Empathy. You’ll talk directly to customers, watch how they use what you built, and decide what to change.
Intensity. We move fast because we’re intense about outcomes and building trust with our customers. If our product is not the best, we sprint to fix it.
Agency. The ideas that can change the trajectory of a product or company can come from anywhere. 
AI-native. We build agents, and we invest in their ability to give us the most leverage possible. You will be in an environment where you are constantly learning how to leverage agents to increase your craft and velocity.
Equal Employment Opportunity Statement
Nooks is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workforce. We believe in providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.
Nooks does not discriminate in hiring, promotion, compensation, or any other employment practices, and we are committed to ensuring a workplace that is free from discrimination, harassment, and retaliation. We encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply and join our team.

Description
Build Your Software Engineering Career on a Mission That Matters
Ready to take your software engineering skills beyond the classroom and into a mission where your work has real-world impact? Leidos is seeking a talented Junior Software Engineer to join the Chinook Program supporting an Intelligence Community (IC) customer and helping evolve an application that plays an important role in national security.
As a Junior Software Engineer, you’ll work alongside experienced engineers, architects, testers, and DevSecOps professionals while gaining hands-on experience developing, integrating, testing, and delivering modern software capabilities. The Junior Software Engineer will work within an Agile development team and will receive technical guidance from senior engineers while progressively taking ownership of software components and features. You’ll have the opportunity to learn new technologies, tackle meaningful engineering challenges, and see your contributions become a part of a real operational mission.
Position may be performed in the following locations below.
Tucson, AZ
Gaithersburg, MD
Alexandria, VA
Chantilly, VA
Englewood, CO
St. Louis, MO
Clearance Level Required

Primary Responsibilities
Develop, modify, test, and deploy software solutions that support our customer’s GEOINT mission under the guidance of senior engineers.
Implement software features based on established requirements and technical designs.
Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code.
Participate in code reviews and incorporate feedback from senior engineers.
Develop and execute unit and integration tests.

Collaborate with mission users and product managers to refine requirements and improve user experience.
Use Git and established CI/CD processes to manage and deliver software.
Maintain technical documentation and development artifacts.

Build and maintain secure, containerized applications using technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, and AWS.
Support DevSecOps pipelines and ensure code meets security and accreditation standards.
Resolve various tasks as prioritized by the team product owner.

US citizenship is required per contract
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field and 2-4 years of prior relevant experience or Master’s with less than 2 years of prior relevant experience. Equivalent experience may be considered in lieu of degree
Experience with the following technologies:

A Tivita nasceu para resolver um problema estrutural: a ineficiência da gestão financeira de R$500 bilhões no setor de saúde. Nossas soluções colocam a gestão de clínicas e consultórios no piloto automático, automatizando tarefas manuais, eliminando processos burocráticos e dando visibilidade de indicadores confiáveis a cada segundo.
Idealizada por fundadores com histórico de sucesso no Gympass/Wellhub e Olist, com mais de R$ 32 milhões captados com FinTech Collective, MAYA Capital e K50 Ventures, estamos preparados para transformar a saúde com um time de gente boa de verdade!
Somos movidos pela arte de transformar o complexo em simples e o impossível em realidade. Por isso, a expertise profunda em Tecnologia, Automação e Inteligência Artificial é peça-chave para acelerar a construção e melhoria contínua de soluções intuitivas, únicas e ambiciosas.
Nosso time de tecnologia
Aqui, somos 
Alquimistas
: questionamos o status quo e reimaginamos fluxos complexos como soluções simples, elegantes e escaláveis.
Construímos automações inéditas para gestão de clínicas no Brasil. É um trabalho que exige profundidade analítica, criatividade prática e coragem para transformar operações inteiras.
Somos 
um só time
, colaborativo e sem ego. Trabalhamos com autonomia, abertura e feedback honesto para crescer juntos.
Nosso foco é impacto real: só paramos quando conseguimos entregar algo que torna a vida das clínicas 
pelo menos 10x melhor
.
E buscamos excelência todos os dias — entrando no detalhe, entendendo causas-raiz e elevando continuamente o padrão do que entregamos.
Se esse tipo de ambiente te energiza, você vai se sentir em casa 💚
Suas principais responsabilidades
Como um 
Alquimista de Backend
, você terá um papel fundamental na evolução da nossa plataforma, ajudando a transformar processos complexos em experiências simples e fluidas para nossos clientes:
Evoluir o coração do nosso produto, desenvolvendo novas funcionalidades com Python e Django (DRF), sempre prezando por um código limpo, sustentável e de alta qualidade. 
Contribuir para uma arquitetura escalável e resiliente, utilizando ecossistemas em Cloud (predominantemente GCP - Google Cloud Platform), e seus subprodutos (CloudRun, PubSub, CloudSQL, e etc) para garantir que nossas soluções cresçam com segurança. 
Cuidar da nossa infraestrutura de forma inteligente, utilizando Infrastructure as Code (ex.: Terraform, CloudFormation, e etc) para manter nossos ambientes organizados e eficientes. 
Zelar pela saúde e visibilidade dos nossos sistemas, aprimorando nossas estratégias de observabilidade, logs e alertas para que possamos agir de forma proativa. 
Atuar com agilidade e parceria na resolução de desafios, lidando com incidentes técnicos com foco em entender a causa-raiz e garantir a melhor experiência para as clínicas. 
Compartilhar conhecimento e documentar fluxos, ajudando o time a crescer junto e mantendo nossa base técnica clara e acessível. 
Trabalhar de forma genuinamente colaborativa, priorizando o sucesso do time, a troca de feedbacks construtivos e o impacto real na vida das pessoas
O que esperamos de você
Buscamos pessoas com sólida experiência em engenharia, que amem resolver problemas e que queiram construir algo relevante em um ambiente de confiança:
Sólida vivência com Python e Django, sentindo-se confortável para navegar em sistemas robustos e propor melhorias. 
Visão sistêmica e vontade de simplificar, com capacidade de transformar fluxos densos em soluções de backend elegantes e funcionais. 
Domínio em APIs e comunicações web, compreendendo profundamente o protocolo HTTP e as melhores práticas de integrações REST. 
Familiaridade com banco de dados SQL, sendo capaz de realizar investigações e otimizações de dados com autonomia. 
Perfil analítico e curioso, que se sinta à vontade investigando logs e traces para entender o comportamento dos sistemas sob diferentes cenários. 
Uso fluído de Git e boas práticas, valorizando a organização e a qualidade do código entregue pelo time.

Experiência em integração com parceiros, lidando com diferentes protocolos, padrões de autenticação, webhooks e o consumo fluido de APIs de terceiros.

vagas.descricao_resumida: 3Y Health - Brasil
vagas.descricao_completa:
About 3Y Health
3Y Health is building the operating system for healthcare practices, an AI-native platform that helps clinicians start, run and grow their practice. We work as a managed services organization (MSO): along with the software, our operations team runs the back office for the clinics we partner with, including billing, insurance and compliance. We currently serve applied behavior analysis (ABA) therapy practices and are expanding into speech, occupational and physical therapy, and psychiatry.
About The Role
Members of Technical Staff own features end to end. You'll work with the clinicians and operators who use what we build, scope the problem, design and build the solution across the stack, deploy it and follow how it performs in production. Our engineering team is flat, with no sub-teams, so you'll work across the whole platform. We build with AI coding agents every day and expect you to do the same.
What You'll Do
Design and build AI agents and automated workflows for clinic operations, such as insurance benefits verification, prior authorizations, patient intake, claims and clinical documentation
Build features for clinicians, patients and families, and our internal operations team, on web and mobile
Take ambiguous problems from 0 to 1, working with operators and clinicians to define the problem, write the spec and ship a first version
Design the services, data models and APIs behind your features and manage the infrastructure as code
Own your services in production: deployments, monitoring and incident response
Write evals for model-facing features and track the metrics of the workflows you ship
Work with protected health information (PHI) safely, with least-privilege access, no PHI in logs and auditable changes
Build and maintain the skills, plugins, MCP integrations and review bots our engineers use with Claude Code and Codex
Our stack
Backend: Python (our primary language for new services), Kotlin with Hasura (GraphQL) on our established platform, plus TypeScript (NestJS) and some Go
Frontend and mobile: React, Next.js, React Native
Data: PostgreSQL (including pgvector), Snowflake
Workflows and contracts: Temporal, gRPC/Protobuf
Infrastructure: AWS (ECS Fargate, RDS), Terraform, GitHub Actions, Datadog, LaunchDarkly
AI: Claude and OpenAI models, Claude Code and Codex, with our own skills, plugins, MCP integrations and an AI code-review bot
Must-haves
5+ years of experience building and shipping production software
Recent, hands-on experience using or building AI harnesses: the layer around a model or coding agent (project instructions, tools and MCP servers, skills, hooks, subagents, evals), not only calls to a model API. You can show what you set up or built. 
At least one personal project you built and published on the web, live and usable by anyone, ideally a SaaS with payments working (e.g. Stripe). Share the link when you apply. 
What We're Looking For
A track record of owning products or features end to end, from an unclear problem to a system people depend on
Strong full-stack skills in Python and TypeScript, with experience across frontend, backend, databases and cloud infrastructure
Comfort working in a large, established codebase
Hands-on experience building with LLMs, including tool use, agent orchestration, structured outputs, retrieval and evals (LangGraph, an agents SDK or similar)
Daily use of AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor. You know how to set them up for a codebase (project instructions, skills, MCP servers, hooks, subagents), run several tasks in parallel and review their output carefully. If you haven't heard of Claude Code, this role is likely not a fit. 
Good product sense and the ability to make solid UI decisions without a dedicated designer, using our component library
High agency: you unblock yourself, look for context and ask questions when you need to
Clear written communication. The team is distributed across time zones and most decisions happen in specs, PRs and tickets. 
Nice to have
Experience in healthcare or another regulated industry (HIPAA, payer and claims workflows, EHR integrations, HL7/FHIR)
Temporal or another durable workflow engine
React Native
Running LLM evaluations or safety checks on model output in production
Having built your own agent harness, MCP server or plugin for a coding agent
Open-source work or internal tools that other people use
If you meet all the must-haves and most of the rest, we'd like to hear from you, even if you don't check every other box.

About Superhuman
Superhuman is the AI productivity platform on a mission to unlock the superhuman potential in everyone. The Superhuman suite of apps and agents brings AI wherever people work, integrating with over 1 million applications and websites. The company’s products include Grammarly’s writing assistance, Coda’s collaborative workspaces, Mail’s inbox management, and Go, the proactive AI assistant that understands context and delivers help automatically. Founded in 2009, Superhuman empowers over 40 million people, 50,000 organizations, and 3,000 educational institutions worldwide to eliminate busywork and focus on what matters. Learn more at superhuman.com and about our values here.
The Opportunity
Superhuman is building the AI productivity platform that works everywhere people do, and Superhuman Mail is central to how people communicate and get work done. Today we are…The fastest email experience in the world
Loved and adored: see what our customers say

You’ll build the tools and standards that let agents take real action for users, and help teams across Superhuman ship AI features faster. We use many models, from OpenAI and Anthropic to open source, and a single feature like Ask AI can route across several depending on the task. Superhuman’s engineers have the freedom to innovate and shape the product roadmap. You can hear more from our team on our technical blog.

Partner with teams across Superhuman to give them the AI building blocks they need
Ship quickly while learning, and adjust course as the industry shifts

An AI enthusiast who uses AI to boost your own productivity and your team’s impact

We invite you to share your knowledge, experience, and goals with us to help us find the best team match for you. Tell us your superpower!

Employer of Record (EOR)
. As your legal employer, the EOR administers your employment, payroll, and applicable benefits locally.

vagas.descricao_resumida: Cruzeiro do Sul Educacional - São Paulo, SP
vagas.descricao_completa:
Olá, somos a Cruzeiro do Sul Educacional!
 ⭐
Nós acreditamos no poder de transformação de vidas por meio da educação de qualidade e excelência! Aqui, nós buscamos conectar diferentes pessoas para que possam construir um mundo melhor a partir da educação, com muito trabalho, respeito e dedicação, proporcionando a melhor experiência e apoiando a jornada do conhecimento de mais de 500 mil alunos.
A Cruzeiro do Sul Educacional S/A é um dos maiores e mais representativos grupos de educação do país, tendo instituições de ensino academicamente relevantes e marcas reconhecidas em suas respectivas regiões, das suas escolas de ensino básico às instituições de ensino superior.
Docentes e colaboradores de diversas áreas trabalham em sintonia para garantir essa construção diária. E estamos sempre em busca de novas pessoas para colaborar com esse objetivo, sejam profissionais que procuram por uma primeira oportunidade no mercado de trabalho, até os mais experientes.
Você se identifica e acredita nesse propósito e quer trabalhar em uma de nossas marcas? Venha fazer parte do nosso time! Estamos de braços abertos para recebê-lo(a).
Para se candidatar a uma de nossas vagas, é importante manter todos os seus dados atualizados e completos. Fique à vontade para se cadastrar em todas as vagas disponíveis do seu interesse, apenas recomendamos que você finalize um processo antes de iniciar um novo.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
O Desafio
Na CSED3, estamos transformando a maneira como interagimos com usuários e sistemas através de Inteligência Artificial. Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de IA brilhante e focado(a) no desenvolvimento de agentes conversacionais avançados e arquiteturas autônomas.
Sua missão será projetar, desenvolver e refinar a lógica de agentes de IA capazes de conduzir interações complexas, resolver problemas de forma autônoma e colaborar entre si. Você será o cérebro por trás da orquestração dos nossos modelos, utilizando o que há de mais moderno na "Família Lang" e no ecossistema Google A2A.
Suas Responsabilidades
Desenvolvimento de Agentes Conversacionais: Criar chatbots, copilotos e assistentes virtuais altamente contextuais, responsivos e humanizados.
Orquestração Multi-Agente (A2A): Projetar arquiteturas onde múltiplos agentes de IA (Agent-to-Agent) conversam, delegam tarefas e resolvem problemas de forma colaborativa para alcançar um objetivo final.
Engenharia de Prompts e RAG: Desenvolver fluxos avançados de Prompt Engineering e pipelines de RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) para garantir que os agentes utilizem bases de conhecimento proprietárias com altíssima precisão e sem alucinações.
Integração no Ecossistema Google: Utilizar as ferramentas e modelos de fundação do Google (Vertex AI, Gemini, etc.) como motor cognitivo das aplicações.
Integração de Ferramentas (Tool Calling): Capacitar os agentes com a habilidade de consumir APIs externas, consultar bancos de dados e realizar ações em outros sistemas durante a conversa.
Avaliação e Refinamento: Estabelecer métricas de qualidade para as conversas (clareza, retenção de contexto, assertividade) e iterar continuamente sobre a inteligência do modelo.
Monitoramento e Observabilidade: Acompanhar a saúde, a performance de inferência e a escalabilidade dos agentes em produção, garantindo a alta disponibilidade e eficiência da arquitetura.
O que você precisa ter (Requisitos Essenciais)
Linguagem de Programação e Frameworks: Domínio excepcional em Python (foco em desenvolvimento orientado a objetos e assíncrono) com vasta experiência na criação e manutenção de APIs robustas utilizando FastAPI, Flask ou Django.
Família Lang (Stack de IA): Experiência prática e avançada com os principais frameworks de orquestração de LLMs:
LangChain: Para criação de cadeias lógicas e conexão de componentes.
LangGraph: Para orquestração de fluxos cíclicos, stateful e sistemas multi-agente complexos.
Langflow: Para prototipação ágil e fluxos visuais.
Ecossistema Google: Experiência no consumo de APIs de IA do Google (especialmente família Gemini e plataforma Vertex AI).
Agentic AI: Compreensão sólida do ciclo de raciocínio de agentes autônomos (ReAct, Plan-and-Solve) e fluxos A2A.
Bancos de Dados Vetoriais: Experiência com implementação e otimização de Vector DBs (ex: Qdrant, Pinecone, Milvus, Weaviate, pgvector).
Observabilidade e Infraestrutura: Experiência prática na configuração de observabilidade, gestão de logs e métricas em produção utilizando Grafana, além de vivência com orquestração de ambientes e containers via Rancher.
O que vai te destacar (Diferenciais Fortes)
Avaliação de LLMs: Conhecimento em frameworks de testes e métricas para RAG e LLMs (ex: Ragas, TruLens, LangSmith).
Integração de Contexto Avançado: Conhecimento em Model Context Protocol (MCP) para padronização e conexão de fontes de dados aos agentes.
Memória de Longo Prazo: Experiência na implementação de estratégias de memória persistente e gestão de contexto em sessões longas de conversação.
Performance: Habilidade para otimizar o tempo de resposta (latência) e o consumo de tokens das aplicações (Tokenomics).
